fieldNotes.location: CORRECTED LOCATION. The roster address (8550 Willard Dr, Breinigsville PA) and coords (40.554158,-75.632566) are WRONG - they land at the Lehigh Valley industrial complex near Breinigsville, an unrelated site. The roster note itself flagged 'verify exact site.' Web research (WFMZ, Modern Distribution Management, TruckMap, Showcase/LoopNet, Lehigh Valley News) confirms UNFI's Allentown DC is the North Valley Trade Center at ~4255 North Valley Dr / 4105 Independence Dr, Schnecksville PA 18078 - two warehouses totaling 1.3M sq ft on 107 acres, leased by UNFI on a 15-year lease. Resolved center 40.66380,-75.59470 on the large main DC building, with 'UNFI' painted on the SW yard pavement (visible in z18 imagery) confirming identity.
fieldNotes.closureStatus: UNFI announced closure of this Schnecksville DC in FY26 following loss of the Key Food customer agreement; ~716 jobs affected, layoffs Aug-Oct 2025. The facility is on the public DC-closure cadence in the Bushway dossier. Audited as the physical yard as it stands; operational status winding down.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: The North Valley Trade Center comprises two large warehouses (UNFI's lease covers both, ~1.3M sq ft combined; one building is ~812k sq ft). Two distinct large buildings on the same trade-center parcel -> buildingCount 2, multipleFacilities true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The main building has continuous dock-door rhythm along BOTH long faces (E face toward the road and W face), with ~90 trailers backed in across both sides in z18/z19 imagery -> band 50+ (estimated ~180 positions across the main building).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on two opposite long faces of the main building (E and W) function as physically separate dock banks -> shipRcvSeparate true (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large paved trailer yards flank both dock faces with parked trailers; the W-side apron is very deep with extensive trailer parking -> dropYard true, dropArea band 50+.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance at the SW corner: a dedicated truck driveway with painted lane arrows leads from the trade-center road into the property through a checkpoint/roundabout area. A small structure is visible beside the entry near the site water tower -> guardShack assumed true (medium confidence; building elevated on a berm above the public road so Street View, 2025-07, cannot see the gate directly). remoteGs false given the apparent booth.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long dedicated approach from the trade-center road through the gate into the deep dock aprons -> drivewayLong true; ample queue room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and multi-lane painted entry -> physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Schnecksville PA is a small unincorporated community NW of Allentown; the parcel is bordered by active farmland on the E and S with scattered rural residences -> per rubric, Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; truck-served grocery DC.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 107 acres per the published North Valley Trade Center parcel figure.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: Estimated 2/2; gate not directly visible in Street View (berm blocks view).
